_readme: Hardware and recovery evidence for the QA gate (custom-fw/tools/qa_gate.py). Fill it in as you do the bench work in TEST-PROTOCOL.md. Every claim needs evidence: a photo, a log or a file path. The gate reads this file; it never writes it.

device.evidence: custom-fw/qa/backups/unit1_v105/manifest.json and console.log (current baseline, firmware Pocket AMP_105, USB 3654:7756); earlier V1.03 dump in custom-fw/qa/backups/unit1. FM-1 Transporter info: key=980F type=3 id=856014

button_dfu.evidence: Tested 7 cycles holding VOL-, PARA, HOME, VOL+ on USB insert. Stock bootloader always boots normal app mode (4C4A:C755)

usb_key_dongle.evidence: FM-1 Transporter method (XIAO RP2040 on D+/D-/GND, USB_KEY at power-on). 2026-10-30: dumps on V1.03 (11c01191...) and V1.05 (66ac9ffd...); full app region (0x5000-0xB5000) rewritten with stock V1.05 and booted; recovery test: app sector 0x5000 blanked -> unit dead (black screen, no USB device on the PC) -> UBOOT entered via USB_KEY -> sector restored with drill --repair -> full re-read identical to 66ac9ffd... -> booted, identity Pocket AMP_105. Logs: custom-fw/qa/backups/unit1_v105_recovery/ (break.out, repair.out, console.log).
usb_key_dongle.hardware: Seeed XIAO RP2040 with the Pocket Amp Transporter build (FM-1 Transporter a632d92, MIT, write window widened to 0x0-0xB5000; built from ~/Downloads/pa-transporter-build), custom-fw/tools/pa_transporter.py

restore_drill.route: usb_key_dongle with the Pocket Amp Transporter build (write window 0x0-0xB5000, info reports win=0-B5000)
restore_drill.result: pass: full app region 0x5000-0xB5000 (176 sectors) rewritten with the stock V1.05 bytes (identical to Pocket AMP.fwsc), each erased/written/read back; full 1 MiB re-read identical to baseline sha256 66ac9ffd...; runapp OK, unit booted, identity Pocket AMP_105
restore_drill.evidence: custom-fw/qa/backups/unit1_v105_patfw/drill_app.out and console.log (176 'PROTO: write sector' lines, no failures)
restore_drill.not_covered: boot area 0x0-0x5000 (restorable with --boot-area, deliberately not drilled)
restore_drill.recovery_test: 2026-10-30 pass: blanked 0x5000, confirmed unit dead, repaired through the ROM USB_KEY route, chip identical to baseline, unit boots as Pocket AMP_105. Evidence custom-fw/qa/backups/unit1_v105_recovery/
restore_drill.last_full_restore: 2026-10-30 after the custom-firmware bench session: drill 0x4000-0xB5000 --repair --full-verify over a custom image, 177 sectors, 0x0-0xB5000 identical to baseline 66ac9ffd..., unit boots stock (user confirmed). Evidence custom-fw/qa/backups/unit1_v105_restore/restore.out

partial_drills.result: pass: full 1 MiB re-read identical to the baseline (sha256 66ac9ffd...); runapp OK; unit booted normally and answered identity Pocket AMP_105
